description: A collection of utility functions and configuration management scripts for OpenWrt, including functions for configuration handling, user and group management, device partition detection, and package post-installation routines.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if DEBUG variable is set.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on multiple hex values of the same length.

methods.name: data_2bin
methods.description: Converts hex string data to binary.

methods.name: data_2xor_val
methods.description: Generates XOR values from hex data.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a variable with optional separator.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends a value to a variable with optional separator.

methods.name: list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a list variable contains a specific string.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration using uci_load or returns if IPKG_INSTROOT is set.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Resets configuration callback functions to no-ops.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Stub function for package handling.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Defines a new configuration section.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list option in configuration.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value with optional default.

methods.name: get_bool
methods.description: Converts a string to boolean representation.

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a specific type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over list options in configuration.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Performs package removal routines, stopping services and cleaning up.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Adds required groups and users based on package control info.

methods.name: update_alternatives
methods.description: Manages symbolic links for package alternatives.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Performs post-installation routines for packages, enabling services and configuring system.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes all shell scripts from a directory.

methods.name: ipcalc
methods.description: Calculates network parameters from ipcalc.sh.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds MTD partition index by name.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Finds MTD partition device path.

methods.name: find_mmc_part
methods.description: Finds MMC partition device path.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a group with specified GID.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Finds next available GID and adds group.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Adds a user with specified UID and GID.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Returns the board name or 'generic'.

methods.name: cmdline_get_var
methods.description: Retrieves a variable value from /proc/cmdline.
